summary.headline: Portents, Epidemics, and Earthquakes
summary.text: Accounts of portentous disasters in the early Islamic years: deadly vapor and sky fire, extraordinary snow and hail in Baghdad and Samarra, shooting stars, epidemic catarrh, earthquakes in Qumis, Nishapur, Rayy, Gorgan, and Fars, and destruction in Fustat. Also records a comet in Sagittarius near Shaula and Batn al-Hut, and a terrifying wind and fire from the Bier toward the Qibla; al-Mutawakkil orders phlebotomy and cupping.
